parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the balancing of a metre rule. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Place the metre rule on the pivot at the 50.0 cm mark. • Place the object Q with its centre on the metre rule at the 90.0 cm mark. • Place a load of weight P = 2.0 N on the metre rule. • Adjust the position of the load so that the metre rule is as near as possible to being balanced and horizontal.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure, and record in Table 1.1, the distance x from the centre of the load to the pivot. Record also the weight of the load. [1]

ms.label: 1(a)(i)

parts.text: (ii) Calculate, and record in Table 1.1, the value of 1 x . [1]

parts.label: iii
